verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs describe "Official Chargebee client libraries and framework adapters" for integrating into applications, and give a concrete Node.js SDK with an npm install command. This clearly covers the core of building against official SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of which other languages are supported beyond Node.js, depth of SDK documentation (typed models, versioning, examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
